name: Synchronicity
source: You follow the story of a 2nd year high school student named Sayuri, who lives in a boarding school but decides to return to the town in which she used to live. The town where her family was killed. Now Sayuri is determined to know just who was the person who sent her away and answer many of her unanswered questions.
translation: 你跟随着名叫小百合的高二学生的故事，她住在寄宿学校但决定回到曾经生活过的小镇。那是一个她家人被杀害的小镇。现在小百合决心弄清楚到底是谁把她送走的，并回答许多悬而未决的问题。
